bio_text: Riya is a 22-year-old researcher at IISc Bangalore focused on energy-efficient neuromorphic computing systems. Her work spans FPGA acceleration, binary neural networks, and hardware-software co-design. With deep expertise in low-level systems and a strong track record of open-source contributions (129 public repos), she's actively exploring the intersection of efficient inference and reconfigurable computing.
